The authored seven-pair medians and ranges recompute from raw samples after excluding pair zero. The large Rust 268.729 us process-mean outlier is retained. Private medians differ and are treated as a separate protocol replay, not a replacement performance result.

The private production pose-publication suppression mutant failed the selected Rust test at warmup receipt timeout. Seven independent report mutations covering missing clock/pose, timestamp, cadence, wall/pacing, ID-byte accounting and duplicate role ID were rejected.

limits: Approval is for the selected paced requested-observation workload and the sampled report.
